higherSupporterRequired.title: Account made!
higherSupporterRequired.body:
Your account has been made, but your supporter status needs to be verified before you can play.

Make sure you used the same social you use for Pony Town and try signing in again in {{minutes}} minutes.

If you aren't a{{tier}} supporter, you can become one by clicking the button above this message!

testServerSignUpText:
Test server is available to all supporters starting from Tier 2.

Sign up using the same social you use for your Pony Town account.

After signing up, you may need to wait 30 minutes for your supporter benefits to apply.

Sign in using the same social 30 minutes later to enter the server.
